authority.menu_path: 右键 → 工具 → 书签同步
authority.room_id: SHA-256 hex of remote key UTF-8 bytes
authority.cipher: AES-256-GCM; key = SHA-256(remote_key UTF-8); payload base64 ciphertext+tag with 12-byte nonce prefix
authority.relay_persistence: bookmark-rooms.json only; rooms hold room_id, verifier, ciphertext, revision; never routes.json

invariants: Only bookmarks and bookmark folders sync. History, passwords, cookies, extensions, open tabs, separators, and Firefox tags/keywords are out of scope.

Canonical URL identity: scheme and host lowercased, default ports stripped, trailing slash on path removed; query and fragment are percent-decoded for equivalence (%2F vs /, hex case) then re-encoded like URLComponents.string (non-ASCII as uppercase percent, e.g. %E7%9F%AD). Host Swift and extension JS canonicalize must agree on that string form.
One canonical URL yields one ledger bookmark entry across all browsers and Macs in the sync domain.
Layout authority: after merge or CLI mutation, connected browsers must match ledger folder path, title, and siblingIndex (create, move, reorder, tombstone remove).
Toolbar, other, and mobile roots keep that root for all nested folders: path identity is kind plus segments; a folder under toolbar does not merge with a same-named folder under other or mobile.

Conflict resolution is last-write-wins on updatedAt for title, folder path, and siblingIndex (no folder-kind priority). Obsolete named paths with the same segments as a rooted toolbar/other/mobile path are dropped in favor of the rooted path.
Empty folders are stored as path-keyed folder records with siblingIndex and are written back.

Within each parent, siblingIndex values for direct child bookmarks and folders are unique and contiguous (0..n-1) after merge; connected browsers must match that left-to-right order. Empty-titled folders and separators under toolbar/other/mobile that are not in the ledger may be removed so indices can align.
Initial merge and late join are union on URLs: unique URLs are kept; absence on one side never deletes.
After a browser or Mac has joined, deletes leave tombstones so old copies cannot revive them.
Tombstone vs create/recreate is symmetric LWW: a folder or URL entry with updatedAt >= tombstone.deletedAt drops the tombstone and keeps the record (local create and remote recreate treated alike).

Layout reconcile may report 已对齐 only when known fingerprints come from measured browser apply_result matching ledger intent (or an equivalent measured tree snapshot), purge of empty-title placeholders succeeded (or is explicitly degraded), and poisoned/unrecoverable URLs are empty. Index out of bounds must poison the URL and must not write ledger-intent fingerprints into knownLayout.

Repeated remove_folder failures for the same pathKey circuit-break after a fixed limit; a new browser tree bumps reconcileGeneration so in-flight batches cannot write back. On each tree, folder tombstones whose pathKey is absent from the browser folder layout are treated as already satisfied for that bridge (seed confirmedFolderRemovals) without clearing ledger folderTombstones; only paths still present in the tree are queued for remove_folder. Folder-removal timeout pause does not require an empty confirmed set.

拓展安装 menu checkmarks reflect current Native live connections (browser:profile after hello), not historical joinedBrowserKeys. Multiple bridges for the same key: disconnecting one must not mark the browser offline while another remains.
Remote key plaintext never leaves Mac Keychain except into encrypt/decrypt and verifier derivation in memory.
Relay stores only opaque ciphertext and never learns URLs or the remote key.
Writes carry expected_revision; stale revision is rejected and the client must pull, merge, and retry.
Bookmark rooms do not use device tokens and do not write remote-control routes.
CLI bookmark commands mutate the same ledger and may pull with the Keychain remote key; they never print the remote key plaintext.

CLI --folder accepts rooted paths: toolbar|other|mobile (and Chinese aliases) alone or as a prefix before /segments (e.g. toolbar/work/a, 书签栏/工作). Explicit named: prefix yields kind=named. A path without a root prefix and without named: is kind=named. Invalid folder strings fail with non-zero exit; rooted prefixes must not silently become named.
CLI bookmark folders [--json] is read-only and exports the ledger folder tree (kind, segments, siblingIndex, child counts, isEmpty) grouped by root.

CLI may create empty folder records, delete empty folders, prune empty shells, and reorder or rename/move folder paths. Folder deletes leave folder tombstones so browser ingest and remote merge cannot revive them; connected browsers receive remove_folder. Deleting a folder that still contains bookmarks is forbidden; toolbar/other/mobile roots themselves cannot be deleted.
CLI add/update upserts folder records for the target path and its ancestors so empty folders remain authoritative after the last bookmark moves out (cleanup is explicit prune/delete).
CLI bookmark apply --file plan.json [--dry-run] applies an ordered list of add|update|delete bookmark ops against the ledger; dry-run does not persist.

CLI bookmark add (and apply add) is upsert by canonical URL: if the URL already exists, the entry is merged/updated and the receipt must expose created=false (merged=true); true create sets created=true.

Folder path normalize may remap other|named paths whose first segment is a toolbar alias into toolbar + remaining segments (e.g. other/书签工具栏/官网 → toolbar/官网), but must not collapse a lone other/<toolbarAlias> shell into the bare toolbar root (that shell must remain addressable for delete).

Formal ledger stays on bookmark-ledger.json and the existing formal remote room. A separate 7-day backup pack lives under Application Support bookmark-backups/ and in an isolated backup remote room; daily job full-overwrites today's slot and drops slots older than today-6 days.

Backup room_id = SHA-256 hex of (remote_key UTF-8 || "\ntocode-bookmark-backup-pack-v1"); verifier = HMAC-SHA256(key=remote_key, msg="tocode-bookmark-backup-pack-v1") as hex; same AES-256-GCM cipher as formal. Backup never participates in browser reconcile.

Restore replaces the formal ledger wholesale from a chosen day slot, then reconciles connected browsers and force-pushes the formal room without merging the restored snapshot into a stale remote formal copy.
prohibited_results: Silently parsing a rooted CLI folder prefix (toolbar/…, 书签栏/…, other/…, mobile/…) as kind=named.
Persisting remote key plaintext, verifier, ciphertext, or URLs in routes.json or diagnostic logs.
Deleting a ledger URL solely because a newly joined browser lacks it.
Syncing passwords, cookies, history, extensions, or tabs through this channel.
Accepting a PUT with wrong verifier or stale expected_revision.
Printing remote key plaintext via tocode bookmark CLI.
Leaving connected browsers with divergent folder placement or sibling order after a completed layout reconcile.
Writing backup pack ciphertext into the formal remote room or letting formal LWW overwrite backup slots.
Deleting a non-empty folder (bookmarks still under the path) via CLI folder delete/prune.
Removing a folder from the ledger without a folder tombstone and browser remove_folder writeback.
Stamping knownLayout from ledger intent after Index out of bounds or without measured folder|index|title matching intent.
Reporting unconditional 已对齐 when purge failed/skipped or poisoned URLs remain.
Letting a local folder tombstone permanently block a newer remote folder recreate (or the reverse asymmetry).
Marking a browser offline in 拓展安装 checkmarks while another live Native bridge still holds the same browser:profile key.

Treating percent-encoded and decoded query/fragment forms of the same URL as different ledger identities between host and extension (including uppercase vs lowercase percent hex, or Unicode vs uppercase-percent forms of the same code points).
Replaying remove_folder for every ledger folder tombstone after each tree when the path is already absent from that browser's folder layout.
Normalizing other/<toolbarAlias> (single segment) into the undeletable toolbar root.
CLI add/apply reporting ok without distinguishing create vs merge for an existing canonical URL.
